---
title: Project name
kind: Work project            # Work project | Team project | Hackathon project | Personal project
role: What you did, in a few words
dates: Mon–Mon YYYY           # shown as written, e.g. "Aug–Sep 2026" or "Fall 2025"
sortDate: YYYY-MM-DD          # used only for ordering; the project's end date is fine
duration: 8 weeks on site     # optional; delete the line if not needed
team: Me and 2 engineers      # optional
summary: Two or three plain sentences a recruiter can follow. What was it, what did you do, how did it turn out.
blurb: One sentence for project cards (200 characters max).
metrics:                      # exactly 3; value max 12 characters, label max 60
  - value: "40%"
    label: faster cycle time
  - value: "12"
    label: stations commissioned
  - value: Passed
    label: customer acceptance test
tags:
  - Tool or skill
  - Another tool
featured: false               # true = also listed on the home page
confidential: false           # true = shows the confidentiality note (use for all customer work)
diagram: browser-grid         # card picture: fleet-loop | phone-screens | card-deck | browser-grid
# gallery:                    # optional screenshots; put images in src/assets/projects/<file-name>/
#   - src: ../../assets/projects/<file-name>/screen-1.png
#     alt: What the screenshot shows, for screen readers.
#     caption: Short caption under the image
# links:                      # optional; must be public URLs
#   repo: https://github.com/you/repo
#   demo: https://example.com
---

What the job covered.

### Approach

How you did it. Name tools, not customers.

### Troubleshooting

A problem you hit and how you narrowed it down.

### Result

What happened in the end.
